scientific_integrity: The exact Gaussian breather and its time-dependent spatial variance are credited to existing kinetic-theory literature; only the phase-mixed three-dimensional radial-mode result, singular Dawson scaling, and separation of radial and spatial modes are asserted as the new mathematical statement. Numerical diagnostics supplement, but do not certify, the analytic proof. No publication or independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only the dilute Boltzmann breather with strictly positive Gaussian variance, uniform physical-phase sampling, and d=3. At least two modes for sufficiently large q, not an exact critical amplitude or exhaustive mode count. No finite-density persistence, noisy measurements, or independently verified publication priority.
title: A double radial shell and a Dawson boundary layer in three-dimensional Boltzmann breathers
